 h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
 # identify 2 pattern and 3 marker

 if not ps:return out
 r0=min(r for r,c in ps); c0=min(c for r,c in ps)
 # pattern's compact canvas is 3 rows by 4 cols in this instance; marker gives 5x6 lattice
 # derive extent from rows containing 2
 rr=max(r for r,c in ps); cc=max(c for r,c in ps)
 ph=rr-r0+1; pw=cc-c0+1
 # marker dimensions
 th=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==3]
 mh=len(set(r for r,c in th)); mw=len(set(c for r,c in th))

 pat=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] if r0+i<h and c0+j<w else 0 for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
 for r in range(r0,h,vr):
  for c in range(c0,w,vc):
   for i in range(ph):
    for j in range(pw):
     if r+i<h and c+j<w: out[r+i][c+j]=pat[i][j]
 return out"}
